mapper.select: SELECT /* isry.drmgs.link.OfcdcLinkAplyMapper.selectMngSn220(관리일련번호(AKA220) 구하기) */ MAX(MNG_SN) AS MNG_SN FROM AKA220 /* 교육청집단연계-파일업로드 */ WHERE ENFSN_NO = #{ENFSN_NO}
SELECT /* isry.drmgs.link.OfcdcLinkAplyMapper.selectMngSn(관리일련번호(AKA220) 구하기) */ AKA220_SQ01.NEXTVAL AS MNG_SN FROM DUAL
SELECT /* isry.drmgs.link.OfcdcLinkAplyMapper.selectStdntAge(학생나이구하기) */ TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), TO_DATE(#{STDNT_BRTH_YMD},'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) AS AGE FROM DUAL /* 교육청집단연계-업로드파일상세 */
SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MOE_SCHULW_DSCNTC_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN ('04','06')

SELECT /* isry.drmgs.link.OfcdcLinkAplyMapper.selectLinkRqstDetList(연계의뢰서 업로드(집단) 상세 조회) */ MNG_SN , ENFSN_NO , INDEX_SN , ULD_RQSTDO_STTS_SE_CD , STDNT_WRTCNS_SBMSN_YN , STTY_AGT_WRTCNS_SBMSN_YN , STDNT_FLNM_ENCPT , STDNT_BRTH_YMD , STDNT_SXDC_NM , STDNT_ADDR , STDNT_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , STDNT_TELNO , STDNT_EML_ADDR_ENCPT , STTY_AGT_CTTPC_TELNO , STTY_AGT_EML_ADDR_ENCPT , LAST_SCHL_GRADE_NM , SCHULW_DSCNTC_YMD , SCHULW_DSCNTC_CS_CN , HNCFRT_HPE_COSE_NM , ERR_INFO_DTL_CN , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM AKA221 WHERE MNG_SN = #{MNG_SN} AND ENFSN_NO = #{ENFSN_NO}
SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS MOE_CD FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MOE_OFCDC_SE_CD' AND ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 = #{INST_NO}
